extDesc.message: Keeps Dark Reader off by default; a three-finger tap turns it on for the current page (Firefox for Android and touch-screen desktops).

rememberLabel.message: Remember sites I turn on (stay dark next time)

rememberHint.message: When unchecked: a page you turn on stays dark only while that site is open in this tab (across reloads and in-site navigation). Tap again with three fingers to turn it off.

notes.message: Dark Reader is kept off by default using darkreader-lock, Dark Reader's official opt-out for sites. Works only with Dark Reader's Dynamic mode (Filter/Static modes ignore the lock, so pages stay dark). While off, Dark Reader's own popup still shows the site as enabled. Add-ons can't run on about: pages, addons.mozilla.org, etc.

toastNotDynamic.message: Only Dark Reader's Dynamic mode is supported

toastSiteLocked.message: This site has disabled Dark Reader
